policies.title: Georgian ordinary passports: Ukraine short-visit visa waiver
policies.summary: The in-force Ukraine-Georgia agreement waives visas for Georgian citizens using a passport of a citizen of Georgia for entry, exit, transit and short stays of up to 90 days in any 180-day period.
conditions: The agreement's appendix expressly lists a passport of a citizen of Georgia among the documents that may be used for entry, stay, exit and transit in Ukraine.
The visa waiver permits entry, exit, transit and stay for no more than 90 days in any 180-day period through border crossing points open to international traffic.

The agreement is indefinite and remains marked in force. This short-visitor ordinary-passport baseline does not establish employment, residence, other special-document treatment, wartime operational access or final admission.

policies.title: Bosnia and Herzegovina ordinary passports: Ukraine short-visit visa waiver
policies.summary: The in-force Ukraine-Bosnia and Herzegovina agreement waives visas for valid Bosnia and Herzegovina ordinary passports for stays up to 30 days during two months from first entry, except for paid employment.
conditions: Appendix 2 expressly lists an ordinary passport as a Bosnia and Herzegovina travel document for entry, exit and travel to Ukraine.
The agreement permits visa-free entry, exit, transit and stay for no more than 30 days during two months from the first entry; a longer stay requires the relevant visa under Article 2.
The waiver does not apply to entry for paid employment. Residence, other special-document treatment, wartime operational access and final admission remain separate.
